posts.title: 4 non-stick myths, busted
posts.caption:
Heard that non-stick can't handle desi cooking? Let's clear a few things up.

Myth: it needs lots of oil. Fact: a few drops is enough.
Myth: iron always rusts. Fact: Tawaana won't rust, and needs no seasoning.
Myth: non-stick warps. Fact: the iron body won't warp on a high flame.
Myth: it's only for gas. Fact: it works on gas and electric.

Which one did you believe? tawaana.com

Dry it fully, hang it by the loop, and it's ready for the next meal.
